thread:
maria-partners: FYI — AWS/GCP marketplace metering workstream kickoff. Need to align on usage dimensions, entitlement mapping (reserved vs on-demand), and reconciliation cadence. Can we confirm owners? :wave:

dan-engineer: I can own the metering API integration side. Question — do we emit token-level metering (tokens_generated) or we send aggregated units (e.g., 1 embedding unit = 1 call)?

kevin-bizops: For the marketplace SKUs we should map three sku types: tokens (pay-as-you-go), embedding_units (per-embed), and dedicated_hours (reserved capacity hours). That matches how we price today.

priya-finance: Reconciliation preference: daily usage export into a staging S3 + daily job that compares marketplace-reported events vs our internal events. Monthly invoice rollup for billing. Need idempotency and event dedupe.

olga-legal: Make sure entitlements language covers reserved capacity refunds / credits and disputes window (we usually do 60 days). Need a clause for marketplace-delivered invoices vs our internal invoices.

maria-partners: @dan-engineer can you propose a minimal metering payload schema for the partner integrations? Keep it compatible with AWS Metering Service (dimensionName, usageQuantity, timestamp, customerIdentifier).

dan-engineer: Draft payload below — lightweight and idempotent. Thoughts?

```
{
  "dimension": "redwood.tokens",
  "usageQuantity": 12432,
  "unit": "tokens",
  "timestamp": "2024-04-30T15:12:00Z",
  "customer_id": "ext-cust-aws-12345",
  "external_order_id": "mp-order-9876",
  "idempotency_key": "uuid-abc-123",
  "meta": {"model": "redwood-4x", "deployment_mode": "dedicated"}
}
```

kevin-bizops: Two asks: 1) include a dimension/sku mapping table so sales knows which SKU appears on marketplace invoices; 2) ensure we can map external customer_id -> internal org_id for revenue recognition.

priya-finance: Also need time-window reconciliation rules: if marketplace reports partial hour usage for dedicated_hours, round-up policy? We prefer to invoice to nearest minute then aggregate to hours for reserved buckets. Document this.

jason-sales: From GTM: we need to surface entitlements in the console for customers who buy through marketplace (so they can see remaining reserved_hours). Any ETA?

dan-engineer: UI work is separate but backend entitlement API will expose remaining_quota per sku. I can prototype API by EOW. Need test marketplace account credentials.

marketplace-bot: [integration-alert] New AWS test account credentials uploaded to s3://redwood-marketplace-tests/ — expires in 7 days.

maria-partners: @kevin-bizops @priya-finance @olga-legal — propose owners: Implementation = @dan-engineer, Reconciliation + GL mapping = @priya-finance, SKU mapping & GA comms = @kevin-bizops, Contracts updates = @olga-legal. Deadline for initial spec + test run: next Friday EOD. Agree? :calendar:

kevin-bizops: Agree. I will coordinate AWS marketplace AM and confirm SKU names.

olga-legal: Agree — I'll draft contract addendum and dispute clause.

priya-finance: Agree. Will set up the daily reconciliation ingest and share schema for the export.

dan-engineer: Will put up a PR with the metering producer and sample events. Also will add a small QA harness to replay marketplace events for reconciliation testing.

maria-partners: Cool. Action items summary:
- dan-engineer: prod metering emitter + prototype entitlement API (owner)
- priya-finance: reconciliation job + GL mapping doc (owner)
- kevin-bizops: SKU mapping table + coord with AWS/GCP (owner)
- olga-legal: contract language and dispute window (owner)
- jason-sales: requirements for console visibility (stakeholder)

maria-partners: If anyone needs sample data or workspace access ping me. We'll run a test replay mid-week and check reconciliation diffs. :thumbsup:

kevin-bizops: One more — edge-case: customers who bought via marketplace but have an existing direct contract. We need a canonical precedence rule. Suggest marketplace entitlement supersedes for purchases made via marketplace; for legacy direct deals we keep existing contract mapping unless customer requests migration.

olga-legal: That precedence rule sounds fine but add a migration opt-in process and a short SLA for changes.

priya-finance: Noted — will flag migration cases in reconciliation so revenue ops can review.

maria-partners: Great. I'll set up a short weekly sync and a shared spec doc. Thanks everyone.
